# Clan icon response fixture

The clan response shape was checked against BeatLeader's public clan-map API during development. The test exercises the same response parsing and per-clan image download path with injected HTTP responses.

`clan-icon-live.png` contains the project owner's hand-drawn clan fallback cover, used as a deterministic mocked server image. The original downloaded clan icon remains excluded in the local review folder. No third-party clan artwork is redistributed in the public fixture.
